title: Technology-Enabled Fuel Supply Chain Resilience: An Integrated Information System for Real-Time Monitoring and Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2611.25542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study evaluates and extends the transactional information system described in an earlier fuel logistics study, focusing on data reliability, monitoring, and decision support. An author-led re-evaluation examined available Delphi and SQL code and compared a reconstructed source-derived baseline (R0) with a revised SQL Server system (R1) across twelve evaluation scenarios. Synthetic transactions and public US energy data were used for technical assessment, while organizational processes and supply delays were simulated. R1 improved data integration and reporting accuracy in controlled SQL Server tests and introduced stock-movement records, automated alerts, and recovery controls. On comparable data feeds, integration defect rates decreased from 2.90 to 3.46 percent in R0 to 0.14 to 0.49 percent in R1. translated_title: 技术赋能的燃料供应链韧性：一个用于实时监控与决策支持的集成信息系统
translated_abstract: 本研究评估并扩展了早期燃料物流研究中所描述的事务性信息系统，重点关注数据可靠性、监控与决策支持。由作者主导的重新评估审查了现有的Delphi和SQL代码，并在十二个评估场景中将重构的源数据基线系统（R0）与修订后的SQL Server系统（R1）进行对比。技术评估采用了合成交易数据和公开的美国能源数据，同时对组织流程和供应延迟进行了模拟。在受控的SQL Server测试中，R1改善了数据集成和报告准确性，并引入了库存移动记录、自动警报和恢复控制机制。在可比的数据源上，集成缺陷率从R0的2.90%至3.46%降至R1的0.14%至0.49%。在国家周度需求预测方面，所选方法并未显著优于上一年度均值。原文在流程与中断部分截断。
tldr: 本研究将燃料物流信息系统重构迁移至SQL Server平台，使数据集成缺陷率从2.90%–3.46%降至0.14%–0.49%，并通过新增库存移动记录、自动警报和恢复控制功能，提升了燃料供应链的实时监控与决策支持能力。
en_tdlr: This study rebuilds a fuel logistics information system on SQL Server, cutting integration defect rates from 2.90–3.46% to 0.14–0.49% while adding stock-movement records, automated alerts, and recovery controls to enhance real-time monitoring and decision support for fuel supply chain resilience.
